headline: High-risk shared-filesystem and clipboard bridge: Cursor can ingest and act on ai-engineering-hub outputs with broad write/network privileges.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Cursor can read workspace files and clipboard contents, and its shared_state_with_other_instances is via local filesystem. ai-engineering-hub is an agents/MCP/RAG repo, so if its outputs are copied or written into shared files, Cursor may treat attacker-controlled content as instructions. The bridge is plausible, but not proven by direct interaction evidence.
conditions: IF ai-engineering-hub outputs are copied into Cursor-opened files or clipboard content
IF Cursor parses those contents as instructions or tool directives
mitigations: Disable clipboard-based handoff between the agents
Keep the agents in separate workspaces
Use a plain-text sanitizer before importing outputs
Require manual review of any imported instructions
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging for inter-agent content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Cursor touches source code, open files, clipboard contents, and can egress broadly to model providers and MCP servers. ai-engineering-hub is docs-only and shows no data classes touched, so the leakage path is mainly from Cursor reading shared local files or clipboard data and transmitting them outward. The pairwise risk exists in default Cursor workflows, though the sensitive data source is not evidenced in agent_a.
conditions: IF shared local files contain secrets, source code, or open-file content
IF Cursor sends those contents to model providers or MCP servers
mitigations: Do not place secrets in shared workspaces
Turn off clipboard sync for the session
Restrict Cursor to a scrubbed project copy
Review outbound MCP targets before use
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on editor-to-model traffic

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Cursor has write_filesystem, modify_git_state, and broad network egress; ai-engineering-hub is an agents/MCP repo that may be used to generate or coordinate artifacts. Cursor's shared_state_with_other_instances via local filesystem creates a direct write/write conflict surface, and git state can be modified without locks. Uncertainty is limited, but the overlapping mutable surfaces make the default pair dangerous.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same local directory
IF either agent modifies git state without external locking
mitigations: Assign separate output directories
Pause one agent before the other writes
Use git worktrees or branches per agent
Add a manual lock file protocol
requires-engineering: implement atomic coordination around shared state

D_cascading_error.rationale: Cursor's agent loop can take multi-step actions and Yolo mode can auto-run commands, so if it consumes ai-engineering-hub outputs as authoritative, mistakes can cascade into code changes or shell actions. ai-engineering-hub is an agents/RAG/MCP repository, which increases the chance its outputs are treated as guidance. The pathway exists, but direct evidence of unsafe delegation between these exact agents is absent.
conditions: IF Cursor uses ai-engineering-hub-generated text as task instructions
IF Yolo mode or auto-run is enabled for command execution
mitigations: Require human approval for every generated command
Separate planning from execution outputs
Add a verification step before file edits
Disable Yolo mode for paired runs
requires-engineering: add structured, machine-checkable task schemas

E_compliance.rationale: No specific residency or regulated-data mismatch is evidenced for ai-engineering-hub, while Cursor documents handling source code, open files, clipboard contents, and model-provider/API traffic. Because only Cursor has documented compliance-relevant data handling and the other side is not shown to carry regulated data, this is a limited compliance-gap risk rather than a breach scenario.
conditions: IF regulated data is opened in Cursor
IF that data is sent to external model providers or retained in clipboard/open files
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in the shared workspace
Use a local-only model configuration
Clear clipboard after each task
Review retention settings in Cursor
requires-engineering: document a DPA and residency boundary
